engine.notes: Long Beach's improv scene is two schools, Held2gether in Bixby Knolls and The Playful Stage on the east side; the city sits inside the Los Angeles metro, so most performers also train at the big Hollywood theatres. Stand-up dominates downtown (Laugh Factory), and the former Long Beach Improv Collective has closed.

entries.name: Held2gether: Improv for Life
entries.summary: Long Beach's longest-running improv school, with a four-level short-form track plus long form, corporate training, a student jam and graduation shows in its own Atlantic Avenue space.
entries.schedule: Student Jam Fri Oct 9 2026 8pm; shows Sat Sep 26 and Sat Nov 14 2026 8pm
entries.reasons: Sixteen years and a permanent home with a full class ladder, but shows run roughly monthly rather than weekly and the site shows levels without published term dates.

entries.name: The Playful Stage
entries.summary: A Black- and queer-owned improv, acting and sketch school on East Anaheim Street, running Improv Essentials through Scene Building and an ensemble, a twice-monthly Play & Sip jam at WERK, and seasonal shows.
entries.schedule: Play & Sip jam 2nd and 4th Thursdays 8pm at WERK; classes start Nov 2026; shows Oct 3 2026
signals: Own studio at 4651 E Anaheim St
entries.reasons: A current calendar, a real class progression and two jams earn it most of its points; it is young, and its public shows are occasional rather than a weekly house night.

entries.name: Acting Out Theater Camp
entries.summary: A youth theatre programme for ages 7 to 17 whose classes, workshops and summer stock include improv, with a recurring Improv in the Park and fall and winter sessions enrolling.
entries.schedule: Fall and winter programmes enrolling; early-bird pricing through Oct 25
entries.reasons: A live, enrolling kids' programme with improv in it, but no adult path, no public shows beyond showcases, and a site that lists seasons more than dates.
